facebook.content:
The Kingdom view of work isn’t “to earn” but “to represent.” Jesus said, “Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as for the Lord” (Col 3:23). When you see your job, ministry, or home tasks as a royal assignment, effort becomes worship and results multiply.  

What task today will you hand over to the King, declaring it His throne‑room work?

What kingdom purpose will you claim today?
